duplicate_order_lines: SELECT ORDER_ID,LINE_ID FROM ORDERS GROUP BY ORDER_ID,LINE_ID HAVING COUNT(*)>1
missing_products: SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN PRODUCTS p ON o.PRODUCT_ID=p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE p.PRODUCT_ID IS NULL
missing_customers: SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID=c.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_ID IS NULL
missing_costs: SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN COSTS c ON o.PRODUCT_ID=c.PRODUCT_ID AND o.MONTH=c.MONTH WHERE c.PRODUCT_ID IS NULL
duplicate_cost_keys: SELECT PRODUCT_ID,MONTH FROM COSTS GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID,MONTH HAVING COUNT(*)>1
duplicate_inventory_keys: SELECT PRODUCT_ID,REGION,MONTH FROM INVENTORY GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID,REGION,MONTH HAVING COUNT(*)>1
duplicate_targets: SELECT MONTH,REGION FROM TARGETS GROUP BY MONTH,REGION HAVING COUNT(*)>1
invalid_values: SELECT ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE QUANTITY<=0 OR SELLING_PRICE<0 OR DISCOUNT<0 OR DISCOUNT>1
row_reconciliation: SELECT 1 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS)!=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V_SALES_DETAIL)
revenue_reconciliation: SELECT 1 WHERE ABS((SELECT SUM(ROUND(QUANTITY*SELLING_PRICE*(1-DISCOUNT),2)) FROM ORDERS)-(SELECT SUM(REVENUE) FROM V_SALES_DETAIL))>0.01
